neighbours.label: the 'Copy' command in UI instructions and 'at' after 'caught <someone>' (catching or capturing something)
fire: Highlight the paragraph, then click Copy in the Edit menu.
Open the share sheet and tap Copy to save the URL.
In the context menu, choose Copy and paste it into the email.
Press the Copy button next to your API token.

Press the Refresh button next to your API token.
